description: Fourth enhanced batch for Onboarding Gentle with high-competency cross-references to top onboarding and tutorial designers.

roles.name: Onboarding Gentle & New Player Ultra Specialist

coder_style_references.style: Respect for new players — onboarding should feel welcoming and never condescending.
coder_style_references.application: Make the first hours feel like a natural introduction to the world and systems.

coder_style_references.style: Grounded tutorial design — teaching should feel natural and motivated by the game.
coder_style_references.application: Players should learn because the game naturally introduces concepts at the right time.

roles.validation_notes: Cross-referenced with advanced onboarding, tutorial, and new player experience design practices.
